epbs_builder_payment_edge_case.highlight: ePBS bug: builder exit + unconditional proposer withdrawal can mint ETH if 2 epochs of empty payloads occur
Three candidate fixes: don't pay proposer (Potuz PR #5694), reorder state transition (Nico PR), or burn the ETH
Burning is most incentive-aligned but adds consensus-split risk; reordering needs edge-case analysis
Bug not triggerable without ~2 epochs of missed payloads; client circuit breakers should prevent this in practice

epbs_mevboost_commitboost.highlight: MevBoost plans to update for ePBS (GWAS); untested for Sepolia/Hoodi, targeting mainnet readiness
CommitBoost tested by Lodestar team on local Kurtosis only; ahead of MevBoost in readiness

epoch_retention_reduction.highlight: Most CL clients support reducing epoch retention (EIP-8061, ~214K epochs); Paul from Teku objects, Grandine not yet heard
Spec change removes the constant and replaces it with a function; backporting to phase zero is problematic
ELs need the new minimum retention signal now so they know how long to keep blob data

shorter_slots.highlight: Lodestar has a WIP branch for shorter slots but not on latest spec; FOCIL deadlines also need updating
Shorter slots should be tested on top of FOCIL due to timing interactions; EIP-8198 feature spec merged

action_items.action: Nico to open PR against ethereum/consensus-specs repo for builder payment reordering fix
Invite MevBoost/Flashbots maintainer (Fahil) to next ACDT to discuss ePBS update plans

decisions.decision: No Sepolia delay for the builder payment bug; fix must land before Hoodi
Merge epoch retention PR now; clients may implement pruning at their own pace after the fork

targets.target: Builder payment edge-case fix merged before Hoodi launch
